implementation: Original carried native PV stores center/deferred-state checkpoints. Selected cells run ascending original K16 arithmetic from zero in device-compacted64/512/1024-key rounds. A suffix certificate combines the final native center, the actual exact-prefix discrepancy, outward double intervals for the original alpha product and the original final envelope minus only a lower prefix-error contribution. It keeps every original suffix local-error allowance and does not assume associative or Lipschitz rounded transitions. Exact replays continue whenever the complete final BF16 bin is uncertain. Original native arithmetic, error bits and candidate membership are unchanged; early outputs are certified representatives, not canonical raw endpoints. Existing runtime dispatch does not include the new header.
mathematical_scope: Conditional on the existing per-step native PV envelope. Its error recurrence unrolls to E_final-A*E_prefix for the suffix local-error sum. The existing finalization is an upper E_final bound. The new prefix lower bound follows the nonnegative state recurrence with gamma(4G), G<=512, a conservative G*2^-16 relative subtraction and G*2^-112 flushing floor. Outward double operations enclose alpha products and signed center corrections. Original reciprocal multiplication and BF16 endpoint checks determine admission. The host test checks the old-envelope sandwich, independent suffix weights, both signs of prefix displacement and BF16 midpoint straddles; native and captured checks independently observe actual original exact endpoints.
correctness_scope: Seven causal shapes including128 queries and the8192 endpoint, six score/value families, both butterfly orders and three checkpoint widths yield252 native configurations. Families include normal/subnormal values, signed zero, very large values, abrupt maxima/zero alphas and unsupported NaN values with complete replay. Every generated output is compared with original all-cell exact PV;672 distinct CPU original dots also match. Capture QK matches independent original tiled QK bitwise; probabilities remain original. Every warmup and timed PV output matches original BF16 context and all29364224 available GB10 cells. Native centers/error bits, original candidate membership, all fully replayed raw endpoints, accepted suffix interval coverage, queue conservation, redzones and unused tails are checked. q8192 repeats the first1023 captured rows and provides no new model token loop. References are observers only.
timing_scope: One warmup and three rotated completed host samples per128-query slab. Timers include native production and checkpoint writes, alpha-weight preparation, original candidate collection, all queue counter resets and every compact replay round. Allocation, workspace reset, validation and immutable-input checks are outside timers. Common prepared QK, probability production, QK input preparation and V transpose are reported separately. No model load, TTFT or product performance measurement.

decision.decision: Keep prefix-certified PV isolated. Every native and captured correctness, interval and memory check passes, and q8192 exact replay groups fall by31.6341%/28.0625%, but complete PV329.6917ms becomes369.6577/336.9665ms at512/1024 keys. The q7169 best206.1540ms versus210.9568ms is small and does not transfer to q8192. No product or default change follows.
decision.next_step: Inspect generated code for the common ordered arithmetic, including remaining private-memory traffic from round barriers. Use machine instructions to establish what changes before any further optimization; retain the original boundaries and measure complete owners.
decision.evidence_limits: This is a conditional operator certificate based on the existing native PV envelope. Early representatives match BF16 and contain the observed complete exact accumulator, but they are not claimed to equal its raw FP32 bits. The q8192 extension repeats first1023 captured rows. Host clocks include the full new producer, metadata and compact replay; QK/probability/transpose are separate. Static resource declarations do not establish measured occupancy or timing causes.
